Method of Attack: Phishing emails pretending to be F5 BIG-IP zero-day security updates that deploy Windows and Linux data wipers
Windows version displays fake F5 security update installer and wipes data after user interaction
Linux version is a shell script that downloads wiping tools (xfsprogs, wipe, parted), removes users, deletes home directories, OS files, partitions, and reboots the system
Both versions communicate device info and status to a Telegram channel
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious executable or shell script attachments
Indicators of Compromise: Shell script named update.sh for Linux
